classification: The existing charger-voltage getter returned 28 mV at the ID-pin decision; the selected threshold chose host, preventing USB export in this boot. Mainline userspace and normal Gemian return were verified.
limitations: The returned value does not establish physical VBUS, ADC validity or why the getter produced 28 mV; the selected helper discards its control-call status and the ADC routine returns data even after a readiness timeout.
The summary masks are cumulative and the voltage is the latest stored value; call counts and ordering are not retained.
No CMDQ task submission or GCE hardware-idle state was observed; absence of a warning is limited to the retained console.
private_evidence: ignored boot package, guarded deployment receipt, host collector records, one-shot console, authenticated changed-boot Gemian identity, and RE VM classification retained
